results.name: 2022 Lotus Emira V6
results.description:
Repositorio de modelos 3D de Ddiaz Design

![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/c/c1/2022_Lotus_Emira.jpg)

The Lotus Emira has been developed on a new lightweight bonded aluminium chassis, technology pioneered by Lotus and which remains an intrinsic part of the company's sports car DNA. That innovative vehicle architecture is wrapped with a bold and sculpted design using cues clearly developed from the Evija. Key dimensions of the Emira are length 4,412mm; width 1,895mm; height 1,225mm; and wheelbase 2,575mm.

Instagram del proyecto: https://www.instagram.com/ddiaz.design/

Paypal Donations: https://paypal.me/sergiodd

Based on a Need For Speed Mobile 3d model

results.name: Lotus Evija Concept (2020) 147493_fbx
results.description: The Lotus Evija is an all-electric sports car known for its exceptional power and exclusivity. With over 2,000 horsepower from four electric motors, it accelerates incredibly fast. Its aerodynamic design enhances performance, and rapid charging gets the battery to 80% in about 18 minutes. This limited-edition car combines advanced technology with a focus on lightweight materials, showcasing a new era of high-performance electric vehicles.
